description: HTML templates for all UX features: drag-and-drop dashboard, Kanban board, command palette (injected into base.html), inline PDF viewer, breadcrumb navigation, activity feed/timeline, batch tagging + smart folders pages, onboarding tour, and template management page.
steps: 1. Update app/templates/base.html: Add command palette modal overlay (hidden by default, triggered by Ctrl+K/Cmd+K). Markup: fixed overlay with dark backdrop, centered modal with search input, results list. JS: keydown listener for Ctrl+K/Cmd+K, debounced fetch to /api/command-palette/search?q=..., render results dynamically, navigate on selection. Also add onboarding tour container div and associated JS.

2. Update app/templates/dashboard.html: Convert group sidebar items to drag-and-drop folder cards. Each group card has a drop zone. Use HTML5 drag-and-drop API (dragover, drop events). On file drop, POST to /api/bulk/upload with group_id. Show upload progress indicator. Keep existing functionality intact.

3. Create app/templates/kanban.html: Full-page Kanban board with 6 columns (Draft, In Review, Approved, Up To Date, Needs Re-Review, Expired). Each column shows document cards. Cards are draggable between columns. On drop in new column, call POST /api/documents/{id}/lifecycle/transition with target_state. Use Tailwind for styling, vanilla JS for drag-and-drop. Include htmx for partial refreshes.

4. Create app/templates/pdf_viewer.html: Inline PDF viewer page using Mozilla pdf.js from CDN (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.min.js and pdf.worker.min.js). Fetch PDF content via /api/documents/{id}/preview. Include toolbar with: page navigation (prev/next, page number input), zoom (in/out/fit), print button. Render PDF pages to canvas elements.

5. Create app/templates/activity.html: Activity feed page. Global timeline showing recent actions. Each entry: icon, actor name, action description, timestamp, document link. Infinite scroll via htmx (hx-get with offset param, hx-trigger='revealed'). Connect to WebSocket for real-time updates (append new items to top).

6. Create app/templates/tags.html: Tag management page. Show all tags as colored badges. Create new tag form (name + color picker). List documents with their tags. Bulk tagging: select multiple documents, assign tags. Smart folders section: list existing smart folders, create new (name + query builder with status/keyword/date filters).

7. Create app/templates/templates.html: Template management page. List existing templates as cards. Create/edit template form with: name, description, required_fields (dynamic JSON field builder), default folder selector, default lifecycle type selector, extraction prompt textarea. 'Create Document from Template' button on each card.

8. Add breadcrumb partial: Create a reusable breadcrumb component. In dashboard.html and document_viewer.html, show breadcrumbs when viewing a group or document. Fetch from /api/groups/{id}/breadcrumbs and render as 'Home > Group > Subgroup > ...' with clickable links.

9. Add onboarding tour logic to base.html scripts block: On first login (check /api/onboarding/status), show step-by-step tooltip overlays highlighting: upload button, search (command palette), lifecycle/kanban link, wiki link, chat. Each step has a 'Next' button. On finish, POST /api/onboarding/complete. Use absolute positioning with z-index for overlays.

10. Add page routes in app/api/pages.py: GET /kanban -> kanban.html, GET /documents/{id}/pdf -> pdf_viewer.html, GET /activity -> activity.html, GET /tags -> tags.html, GET /templates -> templates.html.
11. Update base.html navbar to include links to: Kanban, Activity, Tags, Templates.
acceptance_criteria: All new pages render without errors (GET requests return 200)
Command palette activates with Ctrl+K and shows search results
Dashboard folder cards accept drag-and-drop file uploads
Kanban board displays documents in correct lifecycle columns
PDF viewer loads and displays PDF content from preview API
Activity feed shows audit log entries with infinite scroll
Tags page allows CRUD operations on tags
Templates page allows CRUD operations on templates
Breadcrumbs display for nested group hierarchies
Onboarding tour shows for new users and can be dismissed
All existing tests continue to pass
verification: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
findings: All 669 tests pass. All new page routes return 200. Lint clean. Command palette uses Ctrl+K/Cmd+K with debounced search. Kanban board uses HTML5 drag-and-drop API for lifecycle transitions. Dashboard group cards accept file drops for bulk upload. Breadcrumbs added to dashboard and document viewer. Onboarding tour checks /api/onboarding/status on page load. PDF viewer uses pdf.js CDN. Activity feed uses intersection observer for infinite scroll.
